verification.method: Titles, versions, publication status, DOI, and URLs were checked against official publishers, standards bodies, legislation portals, or primary-paper records.
verification.freshness_rule: Living documentation and current law must be rechecked before a production authorization decision.

scope: External technical, scientific, operational, legal, and assurance references that materially inform KORPUS design or evaluation.

exclusions.doctrine_corpus: Doctrine sources are governed separately by config/corpus/doctrine_catalog_2026.json; inclusion here would conflate product engineering evidence with corpus authority.
exclusions.compliance: A reference records design provenance only. It does not establish compliance, deployment fitness, legal authorization, or a passing KORPUS gate.
exclusions.secondary_sources: Secondary summaries are excluded when a standard, official publication, specification, law, or primary paper is available.

sources.title: Adaptive-RAG: Learning to Adapt Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models through Question Complexity
sources.used_for: Adaptive retrieval-policy and query-complexity evaluation design.
sources.boundary: Does not validate KORPUS routing thresholds or transfer reported benchmark gains.

sources.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations

sources.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
